address: Plaza de Isabel II 7, Madrid, 28013, Spain
bio: Located opposite the Teatro Real (in the Ocean Drive Madrid hotel), Mar Mía views itself as an “urban chiringuito” beach restaurant where everything revolves around the Mediterranean. The varied menu features plenty of options (recipes prepared raw, salted, marinated and with caviar, alongside preserves, tapas and rice and grilled dishes). Make sure you try the “gilda MarMía” pintxo and, for dessert, the most delicate of apple tarts! The restaurant also boats an internal terrace teeming with greenery....
